note: CR-68.5 (Florian, 2026-09-17): same benchmark measured by two runners — show a large disagreement as its own evidence line, and where the versions differ do not pair them at all. A group is listed here only when every board in it measures the SAME task set at the SAME stated version and only the runner (with its harness) differs; the version equality is quoted from the committed registry entries, never inferred from a name. Pairing is for evidence only: the boards keep separate identities everywhere else, exactly as their registry notes require. Unequal versions, a different subset, a different protocol (tools, search) or a different domain are refusals and are listed under not_paired with their reason.

groups.version_equality: Both boards state Terminal-Bench 2.1 as the task set: aa-terminal-bench::2.1 is registered as "Terminal-Bench v2.1 (AA)" on the 89-task verified refresh, vals-index-terminal-bench-2.1::2 as "Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Vals Index v2)". Terminal-Bench 4.0 (aa-terminal-bench::4.0, terminal-bench::4.0) is a different version and is never paired with either.
